texts: No other village on this coast keeps lanterns.
Aelmere Keepers exchange letters with the lantern-keepers of Faltern.

fields.sentence: No other village on this coast keeps lanterns.
parse: (: village_keep_lantern_rule (Implication (And (Member $x village) (Member $x other) (LocatedIn $x sk_coast_1)) (And (Member (sk_keep $x) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $x) $x) (Theme (sk_keep $x) lantern))) (STV 0.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: 'on this coast' is encoded as (LocatedIn $x sk_coast_1), but LocatedIn is containment-only (in/at/inside/within) and 'on' must keep the surface entity-attached head (On $x sk_coast_1).
The contrastive 'other' is flattened to a property premise (Member $x other), predicating a non-property of the village and losing the exclusion of the discourse-salient village.

q2_gaps: exclusionary/contrastive 'other' as an NP restrictor ('no OTHER village') - the instruction set gives no way to exclude an already-salient referent from a quantified range
review.notes: The negated-verbal-generic route (strength-0.0 distributing rule, 0.9 confidence, QuantifierPhrase 'no' companion, restriction as premise conjuncts, bare-kind object filler lantern) is otherwise exactly per doctrine.

issues.reason: "LocatedIn is containment ONLY - in / at / inside / within": a thing positioned by "on" keeps the surface preposition entity-attached, so the premise must read (On $x sk_coast_1), and folding "on" into LocatedIn asserts a containment the sentence never states.

The half that stands is that the exclusion of the discourse-salient village is unencoded (the coverage gap the reviewer files); the half that does not is the defect claim, since (Member $x other) sits in a rule premise - it asserts nothing of any village and narrows rather than widens the strength-0 claim, which is the "carry the restriction rather than silently drop it" instruction of Core patterns.

gaps_confirmed: exclusionary / contrastive "other" as an NP restrictor ("no OTHER village") - no licensed way to exclude an already-salient referent from a quantified range
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form keeps the surface preposition entity-attached in the premise - (On $x sk_coast_1) in place of (LocatedIn $x sk_coast_1) - with the rest of the strength-0.0 distributing rule unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The negated-verbal-generic route is otherwise per doctrine: explicit "no" -> the distributing Implication at 0.0 / 0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, restrictions as premise conjuncts, Theme for keep, and the bare-kind object filler lantern.

review.notes: "lies" is a bare position clause and correctly mints no event; the non-containment multi-word preposition CamelCase-joins to the entity-attached surface head SouthOf, which is licensed by the same open licence as NextTo/AcrossTheLaneFrom. Both proper nouns get their mandatory Name atoms and correctly get no invented kind atom.

fields.sentence: Aelmere Keepers exchange letters with the lantern-keepers of Faltern.
parse: (: aelmere_keepers_exchange (Implication (And (Member $x keeper) (Possession $x aelmere)) (And (Member (sk_exchange $x) exchange) (Agent (sk_exchange $x) $x) (Theme (sk_exchange $x) letter) (CoAgent (sk_exchange $x) sk_group_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kind lantern_keeper is missing its head genus (Inheritance lantern_keeper keeper), which Compound concepts says is always emitted for a modifier_noun with a real head noun and a holding IS-A.

"Aelmere Keepers" is decomposed into (Member $x keeper) + (Possession $x aelmere), minting a per-member keeper kind from a capitalized plural label whose own capitalized run exceeds the bare class word.

q2_gaps: A proper noun premodifying a CAPITALIZED plural common-noun head ("Aelmere Keepers"): the proper-noun-premodifier rule (parse the head normally, link by Possession) and the capitalized-label rule (a run exceeding the bare class word is a name; a capitalized plural label is Name-only with no per-member kind) prescribe conflicting routes, and nothing in the instruction set selects between them.
review.notes: The agent-nominalization atoms on lantern_keeper are licensed because the symbol was fused from the surface, and CoAgent for the comitative "with"-phrase follows the participant-vs-means test. The definite plural correctly takes a group witness rather than Inheritance.

issues.reason: Compound concepts states the head genus is "always emitted either way" for a modifier_noun compound whose last word is a real head noun, and a lantern-keeper is a keeper, so the mandatory `(Inheritance lantern_keeper keeper)` is simply absent.

The proper-noun-premodifier rule (parse the head noun normally, link it with the opaque `Possession`) and the capitalized-plural-label rule prescribe different routes for a CAPITALIZED head and nothing subordinates one to the other, and both emitted atoms are true and well-typed — `Possession` is expressly the loose-association licence and `keeper` is read straight off the head noun — so this is licensed improvisation in gap territory.

gaps_confirmed: a proper noun premodifying a CAPITALIZED plural common-noun head ("Aelmere Keepers"): the proper-noun-premodifier rule and the capitalized-run-exceeds-the-class-word / Name-only-plural-label rule give conflicting routes and the instruction set names no selector
new_gaps: if the Name-only route is the one intended for "Aelmere Keepers", a bare-plural GENERIC verbal clause about that label has no licensed form at all: a Name-only individual is not a kind, so it cannot range an `Implication`, and a habitual "exchange letters" would have to collapse into a single unmarked event on that individual — a licensed form would need to carry kind-hood and name-hood on one symbol
adjudication.defect_summary: Add the mandatory head genus `(: lk_genus (Inheritance lantern_keeper keeper) (STV 1.0 0.99))` beside the existing capability and kind-relation atoms; nothing else in the parse changes.
adjudication.notes: The agent-nominalization atoms are licensed because `lantern_keeper` was fused from the surface, and the noun modifier is correctly left unexposed. The "Aelmere Keepers" routing is a live doctrine conflict, not a parse fault.
